questions.q: What did Mr. B---- want from Jerry?
choices: His vote, and to hire his cab for the election
questions.evidence: he wants to hire your cab for the election

questions.q: Why would Jerry not let his cab be used for the election?
choices: He did not want it covered in bills or the horses racing about for half-drunken voters
He was going away on holiday
questions.evidence: 'twould be an insult to the horses

questions.q: Why did Jerry decide not to vote for Mr. B----?
choices: He thought the man was blind to what workingmen want
He did not like the color blue
Mr. B---- had been rude to Polly
questions.evidence: he is blind as to what workingmen want

questions.q: What happened to Dolly on the morning before the election?
choices: Boys threw dirt on her and called her names
She got lost in the city
She won a prize at school
questions.evidence: have thrown the dirt all over me

questions.q: What did Harry do after the boys insulted Dolly?
questions.evidence: I have given them a thrashing they will remember

questions.q: The boys called Dolly a "ragamuffin." What is a ragamuffin?
What does Jerry believe every man should do in an election?
choices: Vote according to his conscience and let his neighbor do the same
Vote the way his customers tell him
Fight anyone who wears another color
questions.evidence: every man ought to vote according to his conscience
